title: A point redraws every viewer at 30 fps
body:
While a `point` is active, a 33 ms timer in `src/server/compositor.rs` (`PULSE_EVERY`, `start_pulse`) requests a redraw, and every viewer redraws at about 30 frames a second for up to 30 s. Every viewer does draw the pulse somewhere: the sidebar or the rail lists every workspace, so a viewer that does not show the pointed pane still shows its card or tile.

## Proposal

Keep 30 frames a second for a viewer that shows the pointed pane's outline or its tab pill. A viewer that only shows the card or tile redraws at a lower rate, around 10 frames a second, which is enough for a slow fade on a small shape.
